title: Refresh Orderly tables, chart overlays, and account displays
completion_summary: Refreshed Orderly order table, chart overlays, and account display formatting for regular, stop, and TP/SL data
acceptance_criteria: Orders table distinguishes regular and algo order states using the updated parsed model fields.
Trading chart and account widgets surface native liquidation, fee, funding, or trigger-related data where available without inventing unsupported values.
UI changes stay confined to display widgets that do not overlap with the TP/SL entry flow task.
